Vision.

Eliminating emissions through technology.

Mission.

Streamline innovates and commercializes technologies to address environmental and sustainability challenges in the energy, water, and waste industries. We do this by:

Enabling market transformations with novel solutions
Establishing partnerships to scale our products and systems
Streamlining processes through chemical, technological, and digital transformation
Creating long-term customer value and satisfaction

Guiding Principles.

"Humble Confidence" — your teammates and our customers need to know that you know your stuff. But holding yourself in high regard is not becoming, and no one has time for victory laps. It is amazing what you can accomplish if you don't care who gets the credit.

"One Team, One Fight" — every teammate is critical to our success, and we win and lose as a team. Everyone is in sales because our best sales tool is a happy customer. The fight is against accidents, hazards, overruns, dissatisfaction, fatigue, apathy, and anything else that slows us down. Conflict is healthy, but conflict without trust is politics.

"Play Offense" — playing offense is more fun, you can stretch the possible. But you have to be brave, persistent, and even impudent at times. You can move big and fast, take risks, and learn a lot. Offense means adapting, even disrupting yourself. Cultivate a competitive spirit, and never give up.

"Expect Growth" — your career is finite; you should spend it doing great and meaningful work. You should leave this company being more industrious and creative. We owe you equal parts fun and challenge, that is what makes work fulfilling. Learn to live off the land through ingenuity and shared knowledge. The comfort zone is really the danger zone.

"Results Matter, Not Effort" — your job is not done until the job is done. Don't let an issue turn into a problem, eat it for breakfast. Being busy doesn't mean you are getting results. Results require consistency, dedication, follow through. Know your own weaknesses. Having too much on your plate hurts results.

"Lead in Every Direction" — to lead others, you have to lead yourself by staying physically, mentally, and spiritually strong. Leaders are honest with themselves and others. Safety is fundamental to operational excellence; leaders hold themselves and others accountable for safety. Serve one another, collaborate, and always have each other's back. Leaders eat last.

D. JSA / Permit Review

Add a review entry whenever the JSA is reviewed during the job — periodic check-in, scope/condition change (requires new JSA), or after an incident.

02 Hot Work

Welding / Cutting / Grinding / Non-intrinsically safe equipment. Complete items 1-6 prior to beginning hot work.

Fire Watch

★ Fire Watch person shall have no other duties while hot work is in progress. Per regulation, FW shall maintain watch at least 30 min (Permian) / 1 hour (Colorado) after completion.

03 Atmospheric Monitoring
Atmospheric Readings Log

Safe limits: O₂ 19.5–23.5% · LEL <10% · H₂S <10 ppm · CO <35 ppm. Add a new row each time a reading is taken.

Time Initials O₂ (%) LEL (%) H₂S (ppm) CO (ppm)
04 Ground Disturbance

Trenching / Excavating / Hydrovac / Augoring / Boring. Complete items 1-8 prior to beginning ground disturbance. If excavation depth is 4 ft or greater, complete the Excavation Entry checklist that appears below.

One Call (811) Dig Test
Equipment Operator & Spotter
Inspection Log

Record each inspection performed during the work. Excavations must be inspected daily by an Excavation Competent Person.

Excavation Dimensions (if applicable)
Excavation Entry section appears when depth ≥ 4 ft. ★ > 20 ft requires P.E. approval.
Excavation Entry Required for excavations 4 ft+ deep

Complete items 1-10 prior to entering an excavation 4 ft deep or greater.

05 Confined Space Entry

Pick the entry path that applies. Reclassification is for spaces that meet all 8 conditions to be entered as non-permit. If any condition fails, use the Permit Required Confined Space Entry (PRCSE) path.

Reclassification (Non-Permit Entry)

Complete items 1-8 prior to entry. All 8 items must be Y to reclassify the space as non-permit. If any item is N, the PRCSE path is required.

Permit Required Confined Space Entry (PRCSE)

Complete items 1-9 prior to permit-required confined space entry.

PRCSE Personnel Log

Entrants shall review atmosphere test results prior to each entry. Each entry/exit must be logged.

# Entrant Name Time In Time Out Time In Time Out
06 Energy Isolation (LOTO)

Identify the equipment to be isolated, the energy sources, the isolation devices, and the authorized employees who will apply locks & tags. Each isolation device must be verified by Lock / Tag / Try.

All Authorized Employees shall apply a lock & tag.
Energy Sources & Isolation Devices

List items in order of isolation / operation. For each device, mark its position (Normal / Isolated) and verify Lock / Tag / Try.

# Energy Source / Isolation Device Position Lock Tag Try Restored
Equipment Restoring

Complete items 1-7 prior to restoring equipment. Check each isolation device when returned to normal operating position (use the "Restored" column above).

Authorized Employees

List each authorized employee who applies a lock & tag. Mark the first row as Primary Authorized for Group/Full lockouts. Record date/time when locks & tags are attached and again when removed.

Custody transfer: If transferring custody of isolation, the leaving Authorized Employee places date/time in their Removed field. The new Authorized Employee adds a row with their name and company, references the original line via T#, and records the date/time of transfer in their Attached field.
07 Approval, Termination & Review

Approval is signed by the Streamline Representative when the permit is issued. Termination is filled in when work is complete (or the permit is otherwise ended).

Roll Off Swap

Safety inspection record for roll-off bin swaps. Complete this form before, during, and after each swap.

01 Submitter & Location
Enter your name
Select a location
02 Bin Information
Select a bin type
Enter the incoming bin number
03 Pre-Pickup Inspection
Is the truck placing its deck on the railing to prevent damage to the containment? *
Was a bin inspection completed prior to pickup? *
Required: Walk around the bin with the driver prior to pick up to ensure there is no standing liquid, integrity issues, properly sealed/plugged, clear of debris/parts, doors are securely fastened. If a DWB is being picked up, verify this hasn't been used in at least 24 hrs and the DWB has pumped off the excess liquid. Use SWA if this does not pass inspection.
Did you spot, observe, and pay attention to the pickup of the bin? *
04 Incoming Bin Verification
Have you verified with the driver that the incoming bin has passed water inspection? *
Is the incoming bin sealed properly? *
Is the incoming bin properly lined? *
05 Placement
Have you spotted and overseen the placement of the incoming bin? *
Has the incoming bin been properly placed? *
Has the bin been leak tested? DWB only *
Add a small amount of process chemistry (300–500 gal) to the DWB and walk around the unit to observe for leaks. Pay attention to welded patches, doors, and connection ports. If it fails, reject the bin.
